- [ ] No credentials, production telemetry, customer data, or private incident evidence are included.
- [ ] The investigator remains read-only unless this PR is explicitly limited to operator sandbox tooling.
- [ ] Missing evidence is not treated as healthy evidence.

- [ ] Behavior changes include tests.
